title: Runtime calculation invariance and TR/EN localization boundary

requirements.RC-1040: device model cannot affect calculation identity or math
requirements.RC-1041: phone language cannot affect mathematical result
requirements.RC-1042: decimal separator cannot affect mathematical result
requirements.RC-1043: ambient device timezone cannot mutate stored calculation identity
requirements.RC-1044: stored calculation uses its explicit IANA timezone
requirements.RC-1045: now calculations receive explicit current timezone and UTC instant
requirements.RC-1046: TR presentation environment is covered by regression
requirements.RC-1047: EN presentation environment is covered by regression
requirements.RC-1048: different system timezones are covered by regression
requirements.RC-1049: same canonical stored input has locale-independent calculation key
requirements.RC-1050: TR and EN system localization keys have exact parity
requirements.RC-1051: TR-visible system key cannot be missing in EN
requirements.RC-1052: EN-visible system key cannot be missing in TR
requirements.RC-1053: missing system localization fails closed rather than falling back silently
requirements.RC-1054: TR system text is resolved from TR catalog only
requirements.RC-1055: EN system text is resolved from EN catalog only
requirements.RC-1056: user-authored notes are preserved verbatim across language changes
requirements.RC-1058: user data never crosses the system localization-key resolver

promotion_policy: CI may promote NOT_STARTED to IMPLEMENTED only. Device/locale integration, rendered TR/EN UI, production localization catalogs and exact-release evidence remain blockers for TESTED/VERIFIED/DONE.
